prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production reward image for a middle-school science mystery game, one cute potato keychain isolated on a genuinely transparent background, square canvas, ideally 1024x1024.
Primary request: A delightful collectible potato keyring that a quirky professor gives a student for explaining a science experiment in their own words. Make it feel like a charming backpack accessory a teenager would actually want.
Subject: ONE small rounded irregular potato character with a warm golden tan potato skin, subtle tiny potato speckles, expressive friendly dark eyes, a modest proud smile and rosy cheeks. Thin tiny round brass professor spectacles, a miniature dark forest-teal bow tie, and very small rounded hands and feet. It should clearly read as a potato, not a teddy bear, human face, yellow bean or animal. No hat, no extra characters. A substantial polished brass split key ring at the top, linked by 3 short metal chain links to a securely attached loop on the potato charm's head. Ring and chain entirely visible and not cropped.
Style: beautifully crafted softly dimensional 2.5D storybook game reward, tactile resin/enamel charm with gently painted details and subtle specular edges, warm ivory / potato gold / forest teal palette, tasteful and polished rather than a cheap emoji. Soft studio light from upper left. Front three-quarter view with only slight rotation so face, chain and ring are clear. A coherent physically connected keychain.
Composition: centered whole object occupies about 75% of square canvas height with generous transparent margins. Strong silhouette readable at 160px. No ground plane, no cast shadow on a backdrop, no packaging, no words, no labels, no UI, no logo, no watermark, no checkerboard baked in. Keep true alpha transparency.
